name: Izumibashi Shuzo
about: Izumibashi Shuzo has brewed since 1857 in Ebina, Kanagawa, on farmland the Hashiba family had worked for over 400 years. The name joins the Izumi river that once ran beside the brewery with the family's trade name, Hashiba.

It grows part of its own rice and has made only junmai sake since 2006, with half the output made by the kimoto method. All its rice is milled in house, and its water is hard, from the Tanzawa mountains. The red dragonfly on its labels marks rice grown with little or no pesticide.
